name: DrumGen
_comment: MIDI generator with a hand-written VST2 shell (drumgen_vst.cpp, after mpc-vst-euclidier): vst.json/params.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin; build.sh compiles drumgen_vst.cpp itself. Notes go out through the plugin's own ALSA seq port 'DrumGen'.
